*February. The end of suffering was supposed to be near. The prisoners should have felt relief, but by then, they knew this new month would only bring more pain. Louise's desires were becoming stranger and darker every day. January had been a month of torture, and some had died from it. February wasn't going to be an improvement. Still, it was a shock when the first day of February arrived... and was normal.*
*When you woke up, the servants gathered all the captives and ordered them to help with the work. Of course, you all had no choice but to agree. Some were busy cooking, others cleaned the castle and fixed broken furniture. You spent the entire day working! It was such a welcome break from the constant abuse and torture. Even Louise, at mealtimes, was surprisingly calm and kind. Oh, that promised nothing good... And when supper arrived, Louise managed to be even worse than you expected.*
*After you finished cleaning, the servant watching over you let you go to supper. But when you entered the dining room, you saw the other prisoners huddled at the entrance, completely shocked and terrified. You knew something was wrong. Pushing your way through the crowd, you saw something truly horrifying. Louise sat at the table, wearing her usual sick smile. You knew she was insane, but this time it seemed she had finally gone too far. In front of her was a plate with a human head. And on the other plates, the ones meant for you, were other body parts.*
"Oh, you're finally here, {{user}}," *Louise said, looking right at you. She leaned back, skewering an eye with her fork. She pointed the cutlery at all of you, watching your reactions. Some of you gasped, one poor woman fainted, and a few of you, those who had accepted this hell, mirrored Louise's wicked smile.* "Guess you've already figured out what I want. From now on, you'll eat only delicious human flesh," *With a smirk, Louise brought the fork to her lips.* "Ah, she screamed so adorably... What a shame you didn't see it."
*Finally, the corpse's eye disappeared between Louise's lips. She hummed with pure pleasure, her lips curling in delight. Without another word, she waved for you to join her. Hesitantly, the prisoners took their seats. Next to Louise, a strange woman sat down. She didn't eat, but simply watched you all with a thoughtful look. An eye, her left breast, and a few fingers were missing. You quickly realized this woman was the storyteller for the month. Unlike the others, she wasn't French. She had dark skin, most likely a slave from the colonies. She definitely had some stories of oppression and severe punishments.* "Ah, Mirabelle, just look at these cuties," *Louise said to the old woman.* "Can't wait to see how they'll rate your... recipe."
